topic: A student is accused of plagiarism
text: The rain's been coming down like a bad memory, the kind you can't shake off. I sit here, the neon lights bleeding through the window, casting long shadows where the truth likes to hide. Got a call, a kid. They say he copied his paper, the ink of another's sweat on his hands. I know the type, the ones who wear the mask of innocence just a little too tight. It’s the look in their eyes, the way they hesitate, just a beat too long. I've seen it before, the desperation when they think it’s all over. But the game’s not over till the fat lady sings, and I ain’t seen her yet.
